title: A Practical Implementation of Day-3 Cooperative Intersection with Automated Connected Mini-Cars
authors: Lorenzo Farina, Vittorio Todisco, Federico Gavioli, Salvatore Iandolo, Francesco Moretti, Giuseppe Perrone, Matteo Piccoli, Francesco Raviglione, Marco Rapelli, Antonio Solida, Claudio Casetti, Paolo Burgio, Carlo Augusto Grazia, Alessandro Bazzi
abstract: Cooperative driving enabled by connected and automated vehicles is expected to improve traffic efficiency and safety, particularly at intersections where traditional control mechanisms such as traffic lights introduce delays and unnecessary stops. Although cooperative intersection management algorithms have been widely studied, experimental demonstrations remain limited. This paper presents a real-time demonstration of cooperative intersection management using connected autonomous mini-cars. The testbed consists of multiple 1:10 scale vehicles equipped with autonomous driving capabilities and wireless communication modules that interact with a centralized controller responsible for scheduling their crossing of the intersection. Vehicles approaching the intersection exchange messages with the controller to set the appropriate mobility profile to traverse the intersection without stopping. The demonstration integrates autonomous driving, wireless communication, and cooperative control in a single experimental platform, providing a practical environment for validating cooperative intersection management concepts for future intelligent transportation systems.
comment: The work is relevant for research on connected autonomous vehicles, cooperative intelligent transportation systems, smart intersections, vehicle coordination, CAV testbeds, and future urban mobility

title: A Stationary-Distribution Theory for Triplet-Based Plateau Search in Random Forest Ensemble-Size Selection
authors: Andrey A. Dukhovny, Andrey M. Lange
abstract:
The number of trees is a central computational parameter in Random Forests: increasing it reduces finite-ensemble variability but increases training and prediction cost. Plateau-based tuning adapts this parameter through local comparisons of out-of-bag scores at a geometric triplet of tree counts. After the remaining hyperparameters have stabilized, however, the central triplet point need not converge to a deterministic value; instead, it fluctuates around a stationary regime.
  This paper develops a stationary-distribution theory for this process. The central ensemble size $B_t$ is modeled as a birth-death Markov chain on a geometric grid, and its stationary distribution is derived through local balance. Under a leading centered folded-normal approximation, equilibrium equations are obtained for the original update rule and a symmetric modified variant, implying that the stationary center $B_*=O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ as $\varepsilon\downarrow 0$.
  The stationary spread is also characterized. A local Gaussian approximation and a Fokker-Planck interpretation give grid-level variance constants. After conversion to the ensemble-size scale, $σ_{B,*}=O(\varepsilon^{-2})$, while the variance is $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$. The leading relative spread is independent of $\varepsilon$ and controlled by the scale factor and update rule. These results interpret plateau-based Random Forest tuning as a stochastic process rather than a deterministic stopping rule.

title: Contrastive Reflection for Iterative Prompt Optimization
authors: Derek Koh, Jinghui Mo, Benjamin H. Le, Jiening Zhan, Baofen Zheng, Kevin Bevis, Nathaniel C. Owen, Lauren Elizabeth Charney, Wenqiong Liu, Jingwei Wu
abstract:
LLM agents are becoming central to information retrieval: they issue retrieval queries, synthesize answers, and increasingly serve as judges for IR evaluation. Improving the prompts that control these agents is an optimization problem, but in applied IR settings it often looks less like blind search and more like debugging. Engineers need to know which behavior failed, which nearby behavior still worked, what distinguishes the two, and whether a prompt edit improves held-out quality without introducing regressions.
  We present Contrastive Reflection, an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic IR workflows. The framework starts from a task-centric quality definition: QA agents expose retrieval or reasoning traces, and grading agents expose dimension-level scores and rationales. These structured traces are used to identify error-anchored behavioral slices, add nearby successful examples from the same region, and ask a Teacher LLM to propose a targeted prompt edit. Candidate edits are accepted only when validation performance improves, optionally subject to regression checks. We instantiate the framework with a tree-based slice selector, but the contribution is the contrastive reflection loop rather than the tree itself.
  On a public HotpotQA retrieval-augmented QA setup, one tree-selected contrastive repair improves held-out exact-match accuracy from 51.4% to 60.4%. Failure-only and random-evidence variants improve less and break more previously correct examples. A light instruction-only comparison places the method near modern prompt optimizers: MIPROv2 reaches 59.4% and GEPA 57.0%. The result is an interpretable optimization loop for IR agents, aimed at making prompt repair more inspectable and validation-driven.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. To appear at Agent4IR @ KDD 2026 (KDD 2026 Workshop on AI Agents for Information Retrieval)

title: A Transferable Learned Temporal Prior for Transmission Reconstruction and Decision-Relevant Uncertainty in Real Outbreak Labels
authors: Md Ahsan Karim
abstract: Outbreak transmission reconstruction treats epidemiological timing and transmission labels as deterministic ground truth; neither has been systematically evaluated. We trained a logistic regression temporal prior on eleven disease families, locked all parameters before accessing any target outbreak data, and applied it without refitting to a strict Andes virus (ANDV) parent-ranking benchmark of 29 tasks. The locked prior achieved mean reciprocal rank (MRR) 0.571 versus 0.274 and Top-1 accuracy 37.9% versus 13.8% against the best source-trained parametric baseline (permutation p <= 0.0002; 7-8 reversals to lose MRR significance). A phylogenetic concordance audit of 75 NYC mpox inter-host pairs - independent label-reliability evidence rather than a prior validation - found that 54.67% (exact 95% CI: 42.75-66.21%) were genomically unresolved or unsupported. Retaining uncertain edges in ANDV and Guangdong Delta graphs shifted top-5 source-priority sets (Jaccard 0.429-0.667). Transmission-label uncertainty was measurable in the outbreak evidence modules examined, and retaining uncertain links changed which source cases were prioritized for intervention.

title: How Can AI Find My Model? A Model-Finding Experimental Study Considering Data Formats, Embeddings, and Retrieval Strategies
authors: Jhon G. Botello, Jose J. Padilla, Erika Frydenlund, Krzysztof Rechowicz, Eric Weisel
abstract: Discovering simulation models for reuse remains a fundamental challenge in Modeling and Simulation (M&S). When many models coexist, identifying those that align with a given modeling intent remains difficult. Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly retrieval-based approaches, offer a promising pathway to operate at this semantic layer. In this paper, we present an experimental study investigating the impact of data representation, transformer-based embedding models, and retrieval strategies on the discovery of simulation models using natural language queries. We evaluated performance across multiple query types using standard information retrieval metrics, including recall@5 and nDCG@5. Results show that data representation matters, open-source embedding models can achieve high performance, and reranking methods are important, especially as query complexity increases. This work provides a baseline for AI-driven model discovery and discusses its role in advancing toward AI-driven composability and interoperability.
comment: Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference (WSC 2026). The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore

title: TinyML for On-Device and Edge Analytics in Wireless Networks: A Survey of Deployments, Opportunities, and Concept-Drift Mitigation
authors: Prasoon Raghuwanshi, Vimal Bhatia, Sridhar Iyer, Matti Latva-aho, Onel Luis Alcaraz López
abstract: Ubiquitous intelligence is essential for enabling real-time, adaptive, autonomous, and scalable operations in the next generation of wireless networks. However, this poses significant challenges in data management and energy consumption on the end-device/edge side, specially under dynamic environmental conditions. This has driven the adoption of tiny machine learning (tinyML), which offers data-driven optimization at the end-device/edge side. In this work, we survey and thoroughly discuss various tapped/untapped deployment possibilities of tinyML in wireless networks. We identify existing frameworks, accustomed to design tinyML algorithms, that could be utilized to solve a range of wireless network problems. We present a federated learning-based tinyML model update procedure, for both battery-powered and batteryless end-devices, to resolve the concept drift problem faced by tinyML models. Furthermore, we discuss the update-aware checkpointing, fault-tolerant bootloader, and intermittent-aware modify operation, which could support federated learning-based tinyML model update in the case of batteryless end-devices. Overall, this paper spells out several areas where end-device/edge intelligence can be utilized in the next generation of wireless systems, as well as ways to mitigate the concept drift problem faced in the case of end-device intelligence.

title: BayesBench: Evaluating LLM Belief Trajectories Under Multi-Turn Evidence Accumulation
authors: Ankur Samanta, Akshayaa Magesh, Tal Lancewicki, Ayush Jain, Youliang Yu, Paul Sajda, Kaveh Hassani, Aditya Modi, Daniel R. Jiang, Yonathan Efroni
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically deployed in multi-turn conversations, where each turn provides new evidence that should reduce epistemic uncertainty about their environment. Acting rationally then requires inferring the unobserved quantities that govern it and updating beliefs about them as evidence accumulates. Yet most evaluations only score the model's final-turn answer in a single-turn format, leaving this process unexamined. We ask how closely LLMs' belief updates match those of a rational Bayesian reasoner in multi-turn settings, and introduce BayesBench, a suite of simulation environments that probe this across three progressively complex tasks: (i) Bayesian estimation, where the model infers an unknown parameter from sequential evidence; (ii) Bayesian prediction, where the model turns inferred beliefs about a latent variable into outcome forecasts; and (iii) latent-framed Bayesian prediction, where observations are filtered through a user-persona framing, requiring joint inference over the latent state and the persona. Across seven LLMs (3B--70B), scaling improves latent inference and evidence accumulation, with updates occasionally matching the Bayesian posterior. However, these gains do not reliably carry over to downstream prediction, exposing a gap between inferring latent structure and using it to rationally update beliefs about the target outcome.

title: StreamGuard: Low-Overhead Resilience for Real-time HPC Data Streams
authors: Hai Duc Nguyen, Bogdan Nicolae, Tekin Bicer, Amal Gueroudji, Matthieu Dorier, Kyle Chard, Ian Foster
abstract: Real-time scientific workflows operate on continuous data streams and must produce timely, high-quality results despite executing on complex, failure-prone infrastructure. Hardware faults, network disruptions, and performance anomalies caused by resource contention or system heterogeneity can severely degrade performance and violate real-time constraints. We focus on strengthening the resilience of the producer-consumer streaming pattern, a fundamental building block of scientific streaming workflows. We present two complementary techniques: (i) a dynamic, asynchronous, non-blocking checkpointing mechanism that preserves progress without interrupting computation, and (ii) a progress-aware load redistribution strategy that detects slow workers and proactively rebalances tasks. Together, these mechanisms maintain forward progress and balanced execution even in highly error-prone environments. Experimental results show that our approach reduces the impact of failures and performance anomalies by up to 6x, while introducing less than 1% overhead in failure-free execution.

title: SyncCache: Exploiting Asymmetric Dynamics for Fast Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
authors: Juncheng Ma, Yuxuan Du, Yanan Sun, Zhening Xing, Changlin Li, Zhenyu Tang, Bo Li, Peng-Tao Jiang, Li Yuan, Daquan Zhou, Yonghong Tian
abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have significantly advanced audio-driven portrait animation, but their high computational cost leads to substantial inference latency. Although training-free diffusion caching accelerates inference significant, existing methods are primarily developed for text-conditioned generation and overlook the spatial and modality imbalances inherent in audio-driven portrait animation. In this paper, we propose SyncCache, a training-free caching acceleration method tailored for DiT-based portrait animation that explicitly exploits asymmetric dynamics. Specifically, high-frequency dynamics driven by audio conditions and concentrated in human regions are more challenging and critical to cache and reuse than the low-frequency visual background in portrait animation. First, we introduce Spatially-Asymmetric Probing to prioritize error sensitivity in dynamic human region. Second, through Modality-Decoupled Caching, we bypass heavy DiT block by reusing stable inter-block residuals, while continuously recomputing lightweight audio blocks to preserve precise lip synchronization. Furthermore, we introduce a cache ratio to control cache capacity and formulate memory-adaptive cache selection as an offline dynamic programming problem without online overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SyncCache achieves superior speed-quality trade-offs, delivering up to 4.12x acceleration on HunyuanVideo-Avatar and 3.75x on Wan-S2V with near-lossless visual fidelity and precise audio alignment.

title: Test-Time Verification for Text-to-SQL via Outcome Reward Models
authors: Mattia Tritto, Giuseppe Farano, Dario Di Palma, Gaetano Rossiello, Fedelucio Narducci, Dharmashankar Subramanian, Tommaso Di Noia
abstract: Improving the reliability of large language models (LLMs) at inference time is a central challenge in structured reasoning tasks such as Text-to-SQL. Common test-time inference strategies, including Best-of-N sampling and Majority Voting, rely on heuristic signals such as execution success or output frequency, which provide limited semantic discrimination across candidate outputs. In this work, we study Outcome Reward Models (ORMs) as learned semantic scoring functions for test-time verification in Text-to-SQL. While ORMs have been previously explored for test-time scaling and alignment, their application to structured query generation remains underexplored. We introduce GradeSQL, a scalable framework for training task-specific ORMs via automated candidate generation and execution-based labeling, enabling verifier training without manual annotation. We integrate ORMs into a verification-driven Best-of-N pipeline and evaluate our approach on the BIRD and Spider benchmarks across multiple open-source LLM families. ORM-based selection consistently outperforms execution-based Best-of-N and Majority Voting, with gains of up to +4.33% on BIRD and +2.10% on Spider. We further show that ORMs scale effectively with larger candidate sets and yield stronger improvements on complex queries. Overall, our results demonstrate that ORM-based verification provides a simple, effective, and scalable alternative to heuristic test-time selection strategies for Text-to-SQL. Code datasets and models are publicly available.
comment: Accepted to the SURGeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026, San Diego, US

title: Multilingual Polarization Detection Using Transformer-Based Models with Class Weighting and Threshold Tuning
authors: Aaron Bundi Anampiu
abstract: This paper describes our submission to SemEval-2026 Task 9 on detecting multilingual, multicultural, and multievent online polarization. We address all three subtasks: binary polarization detection, polarization type classification, and manifestation identification for English and Swahili. Our approach leverages transformer-based models (RoBERTa-base for English, AfroXLMR-base for Swahili) with class-weighted loss functions to address severe label imbalance and per-label threshold tuning to optimize multi-label classification. On the test set, we achieve F1 macro scores of 0.7901 (English) and 0.7910 (Swahili) for Subtask 1, 0.4615 (English) and 0.4808 (Swahili) for Subtask 2 and 0.4791 (English) and 0.5830 (Swahili) for Subtask 3, which give competitive performance on the leaderboard, demonstrating the effectiveness of our methods for handling imbalanced multi-label polarization detection. Our error analysis reveals that models struggle with dehumanization detection and lack of empathy.

title: When Do Staging Annotations Preserve Semantics? Mechanizing Typed Semantics-Preserving Multi-Stage Programming with Let-Insertion (Extended Version)
authors: Jun Tan, Guannan Wei
abstract:
Multi-stage programming with quotations has long provided a powerful way to generate and manipulate code. By treating code as data, programmers can write multi-stage programs in which earlier stages produce specialized code from inputs available at generation time. Modern typed multi-stage languages (e.g., MetaML, MetaOCaml, Template Haskell, and Scala 3) adopt quotation/splicing constructs while enforcing the well-typedness of generated code. However, manipulating code fragments syntactically can subtly change evaluation order, leading to semantic discrepancies between a staged program and its unstaged counterpart, which is intended to serve as a reference implementation in many cases. The inconsistency complicates reasoning about correctness, and prevents staged code from being a drop-in replacement for its unstaged counterpart.
  In this paper, we study the design of multi-stage languages with semantics preservation guarantees. We develop two statically typed two-stage calculi, $λ_{|2|}$ and $λ^{ref}_{|2|}$, the latter supporting mutable references in the second stage. Their dynamic semantics models automatic let-insertion, tracked as a control effect in a lightweight type-and-effect system, enabling type-safe and semantics-preserving manipulation of effectful code fragments. We develop binary logical relations to prove strong semantics-preservation theorems: if a well-typed two-stage program $t_1$ evaluates to a value $\mathsf{code} t_2$, then $t_2$ is contextually equivalent to the stage-erasure of $t_1$. Our calculi and their mechanized metatheory provide a simple and definitive answer to the question posed by Inoue and Taha of when staging annotations preserve semantics, and lay a foundation for future work on semantics-preserving multi-stage programming.
comment: 29 pages; preprint of paper accepted at OOPSLA 2026

title: When Does Learning to Stop Help? A Cost-Aware Study of Early Exits in Reasoning Models
authors: Zhe Dong, Fang Qin, Manish Shah
abstract: Reasoning models spend different amounts of useful computation across instances, but it remains unclear when a learned stopping rule improves over simple confidence or convergence thresholds. We study this question with LearnStop, a hidden-state-free checkpoint stopper for reasoning language models. At fixed budget checkpoints, LearnStop probes a short answer from the current reasoning prefix and predicts prefix correctness from online features such as answer confidence, entropy, prefix vote share, answer stability, and backtracking-marker density. Across 18 task-model settings spanning GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, AIME-90, GPQA, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1 distillations, the answer is task-dependent. On free-form math, learned multi-feature stopping improves the fixed-budget frontier and often beats scalar exits: on GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, the empirical frontier reaches a post-hoc peak adapt gain of +0.157, validation-selected operating points preserve positive gains, and the paired gain over the strongest scalar baseline is +0.028. On multiple-choice and very hard settings, scalar confidence, entropy, or stability rules are competitive or stronger. We therefore frame learned stopping not as a universal replacement for scalar exits, but as a tool whose value depends on trajectory structure. We further provide validation-selected operating points, paired bootstrap tests, finite-grid lost-correct risk calibration, cost accounting under KV-fork, prefix-cache, and black-box regimes, H100 serving profiles, checkpoint-schedule sweeps, transfer analyses, and robustness checks. The main practical finding is that learned stopping is useful when many questions become correct before full budget but do not exhibit a single reliable scalar stopping signal; its benefits largely disappear when confidence or answer convergence already solves the stopping problem.

title: Editable Physically-based Reflections in Raytraced Gaussian Radiance Fields
authors: Yohan Poirier-Ginter, Jeffrey Hu, Jean-François Lalonde, George Drettakis
abstract: Radiance fields such as 3D Gaussian Splatting allow real-time rendering of scenes captured from photos. They also reconstruct most specular reflections with high visual quality, but typically model them with "fake" reflected geometry, using primitives behind the reflector. Our goal is to correctly reconstruct the reflector and the reflected objects such as to make specular reflections editable. We present a proof of concept which exploits promising learning-based methods to extract diffuse and specular buffers from photos, as well as geometry and BRDF buffers. Our method builds on three key components. First, by using diffuse and specular buffers of input training views, we optimize a diffuse version of the scene and use path tracing to efficiently generate physically based specular reflections. Second, we present a specialized training method that allows this process to converge. Finally, we present a fast ray tracing algorithm for 3D Gaussian primitives that enables efficient multi-bounce reflections. Our method reconstructs reflectors and reflected objects, including those not seen in the input images, in a unique scene representation. Our solution allows real-time, consistent editing of captured scenes with specular reflections, including multi-bounce effects, changing roughness, and more. We mainly show results using ground truth buffers from synthetic scenes, and also preliminary results in real scenes with currently imperfect learning-based buffers. Code and data are available at: https://repo-sam.inria.fr/nerphys/editable-gaussian-reflections/
comment: 12 pages plus supplementary material, 20 pages total; SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Conference Papers
zh_title: 光线追踪高斯辐射场中的可编辑物理反射
translation: 辐射场（如3D高斯泼溅）能够实时渲染从照片中捕获的场景。它们虽然能重建出具有高视觉质量的绝大多数镜面反射，但通常是通过在反射体后方使用图元来模拟“虚假”的反射几何。我们的目标是正确重建反射体和被反射的物体，从而使镜面反射变得可编辑。我们提出了一种概念验证方法，该方法利用富有前景的基于学习的方法从照片中提取漫反射和镜面反射缓冲区，以及几何和BRDF（双向反射分布函数）缓冲区。我们的方法构建在三个关键组件之上。首先，通过使用输入训练视图的漫反射和镜面反射缓冲区，我们优化了场景的漫反射版本，并使用路径追踪来高效生成基于物理的镜面反射。其次，我们提出了一种专门的训练方法以使该过程收敛。最后，我们提出了一种针对3D高斯图元的快速光线追踪算法，以实现高效的多弹射反射。我们的方法在单一场景表示中重建了反射体和被反射物体，包括那些在输入图像中未被观察到的物体。我们的解决方案允许对包含镜面反射的捕获场景进行实时、一致的编辑，包括多弹射效果、改变粗糙度等。我们主要展示了使用合成场景地面真值缓冲区的效果，以及在当前使用不完美基于学习的缓冲区的真实场景中的初步结果。代码和数据可在以下网址获取：https://repo-sam.inria.fr/nerphys/editable-gaussian-reflections/
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合光线追踪与3D高斯泼溅的方法，通过重建真实的反射几何与材质属性，实现了对场景中物理镜面反射（如粗糙度改变和多弹射）的实时、一致编辑。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将物理光线追踪与3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）相结合，解决了神经辐射场中反射几何“虚假”且无法编辑的长期痛点。通过解耦漫反射和镜面反射并引入快速高斯光线追踪，实现了高质量的多弹射反射和材质编辑。其局限性在于，在真实场景中高度依赖于目前尚不完美的学习型缓冲区提取技术，这可能会影响重建的精度，但作为概念验证，该工作为可编辑的物理神经渲染奠定了重要基础。
motivation: 现有的三维高斯泼溅等辐射场方法在模拟镜面反射时，通常在反射面后方使用“虚假”的几何图元，导致反射无法被编辑。本研究旨在正确重建反射体和被反射物体，从而实现镜面反射的物理一致性和可编辑性。
method: 该方法包含三个关键组件：1. 利用输入视图的漫反射和镜面反射缓冲区优化场景的漫反射版本，并结合路径追踪生成基于物理的镜面反射；2. 采用专门的训练方法以确保优化过程的收敛；3. 设计了一种针对3D高斯图元的快速光线追踪算法，以支持高效的多弹射反射。
results: 该方法能够在单一场景表示中重建反射体和被反射物体（包括输入图像中未直接观察到的部分）。这使得用户能够对捕获的场景进行实时且一致的编辑，例如修改表面粗糙度和实现多弹射反射效果。在合成场景（使用真实缓冲区）和真实场景（使用学习得到的缓冲区）中均展示了有效性。
conclusion: 本研究成功证明了在光线追踪高斯辐射场中实现基于物理且可编辑反射的可行性，为未来实时、一致的场景材质和光照编辑开辟了新的技术路径。

title: Less Deliberate in Teams: Student LLM Use Across Individual and Collaborative Work
authors: Sehrish Basir Nizamani, Zannah Ziew, Saad Nizamani, Khyati Goyal
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become common in computing courses, we need to understand how the social setting shapes how students use them. This paper reports findings from a semester-long study of 96 undergraduate students who completed six assignments, alternating between individual homework and team project milestones. We tracked LLM usage, prompting habits, and how students verified AI-generated output across all six assignments. LLM usage dropped by 42.7 percentage points when students moved from individual work to their first team milestone, then partly recovered in later team tasks. Students also wrote fewer and simpler prompts, used fewer intentional prompting strategies, and checked LLM output less carefully. The share of students who ran tests on AI-generated code fell by 19.4 percentage points during team assignments and never fully rebounded. A within-student analysis found that 18.9% of students who consistently used LLMs on their own stopped using them entirely in teams, while only 3.2% went the other direction. These results suggest that collaborative context is associated with reduced deliberate LLM engagement beyond what task type alone can explain. The moment students form teams appears to be a critical and currently unsupported turning point in computing course design.
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at ACM SIGCSE Virtual 2026 (November 12-15, 2026)
zh_title: 团队中不那么深思熟虑：学生在个人与协作工作中使用大语言模型的情况
translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在计算机课程中变得普遍，我们需要了解社交环境如何塑造学生使用它们的方式。本文报告了一项针对96名本科生、为期一学期的研究结果。这些学生完成了六次作业，在个人家庭作业和团队项目里程碑之间交替进行。我们追踪了所有六次作业中LLM的使用情况、提示习惯以及学生如何验证AI生成的输出。当学生从个人工作转向第一个团队里程碑时，LLM的使用率下降了42.7个百分点，随后在后期的团队任务中有所回升。学生们写的提示词更少且更简单，使用的刻意提示策略更少，对LLM输出的检查也更不仔细。在团队作业期间，对AI生成的代码进行测试的学生比例下降了19.4个百分点，且从未完全反弹。一项针对学生内部的分析发现，在个人工作中持续使用LLM的学生中，有18.9%在团队中完全停止使用，而相反方向的仅占3.2%。这些结果表明，协作环境与LLM刻意参与度的降低相关，这超出了任务类型本身所能解释的范围。学生组建团队的时刻似乎是计算机课程设计中一个关键且目前尚未得到支持的转折点。
tldr: 研究表明，学生在团队协作中比在个人作业中更少使用大语言模型（LLM），且在团队中编写的提示词更简单、对AI生成代码的测试和验证严谨度也显著下降。
ai_comments: 这项研究非常新颖且具有现实意义，它首次将社交环境（个人 vs 团队）引入到学生使用大语言模型（LLM）的行为分析中。研究结果揭示了团队合作中“社会懈怠”或“协作干扰”可能导致学生对AI工具的深思熟虑度降低，这为未来计算机科学教育中如何设计合理的AI辅助教学提供了重要的实证依据。其局限性可能在于样本仅限于单一课程或特定学校的本科生。
motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）在计算机课程中的普及，需要深入了解社交环境（个人单独工作 vs 团队协作）如何影响学生使用这些AI工具的方式和习惯。
method: 对96名本科生进行了一项为期一学期的研究。学生们完成了六次作业，在个人作业和团队项目里程碑之间交替进行。研究全程追踪并分析了学生的LLM使用率、提示词习惯以及对AI生成代码的验证行为。
results: 从个人过渡到首次团队任务时，LLM使用率骤降42.7个百分点；团队合作中，学生编写的提示词更少、更简单，且对输出结果的检查更不仔细（测试AI生成代码的比例下降了19.4个百分点）；18.9%在个人作业中坚持使用LLM的学生在团队中完全停用，而反向转变的仅占3.2%。
conclusion: 协作环境与学生对LLM的深思熟虑（deliberate）参与度降低密切相关，这种变化超出了任务类型本身的影响。学生组建团队的时刻是计算机课程设计中一个关键但目前缺乏支持的转折点。

title: Beyond expert users: agents should help users construct preferences, not just elicit them
authors: Irena Saracay, Ludwig Schmidt, Carlos Guestrin
abstract: Agents typically assume an expert user -- one with well-formed preferences about what they want -- and default to clarifying questions whenever the task is underspecified. We argue this assumption is unrealistic. Users often lack the domain knowledge to have completely specified preferences; if asked about their preference on some feature, the user may be unable to answer without the agent helping the user to learn some domain knowledge needed to form a preference for that feature, e.g., via examples or explanations. To formalize these principles, we draw on the Search-Experience-Credence framework from Information Economics to introduce CoPref, a model of how users construct preferences based on agent dialog actions. We then study these ideas concretely in agentic recommender systems, proposing CoShop, an interactive benchmark. In CoShop, an agent converses with and makes recommendations for a CoPref user. The agent's performance depends on whether it can help the user gain the knowledge needed to specify the task well. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that no agent exceeds 56% accuracy on CoShop despite five turns of interaction. Failures stem not from agents' ability to find items, but from how little the interaction expands what users know about what they want.
zh_title: 超越专家用户：智能体应当帮助用户构建偏好，而非仅仅引导偏好
translation: 智能体通常假设用户是“专家用户”——即对自己的需求有着完善偏好的用户，并且在任务未完全明确时默认进行澄清提问。我们认为这种假设是不切实际的。用户往往缺乏足够的领域知识来形成完全具体的偏好；如果被问及对某些特征的偏好，用户可能无法在没有智能体帮助其学习形成该特征偏好所需的领域知识（例如通过示例或解释）的情况下做出回答。为了将这些原则形式化，我们借鉴了信息经济学中的“搜索-体验-信任”框架，引入了CoPref，一个基于智能体对话行为模拟用户如何构建偏好的模型。接着，我们在智能体推荐系统中具体研究了这些思想，提出了一个交互式基准CoShop。在CoShop中，智能体与CoPref用户进行对话并向其提出推荐。智能体的性能取决于它能否帮助用户获取充分明确任务所需的知识。通过对五个前沿模型进行评估，我们发现，尽管进行了五轮交互，没有一个智能体在CoShop上的准确率超过56%。失败的原因并非源于智能体寻找物品的能力，而在于交互在多大程度上扩展了用户对自己需求的认知。
tldr: 智能体不应假设用户拥有完善的偏好，而应通过提供领域知识帮助用户构建偏好；为此，本文提出了CoPref模型和CoShop交互式基准，评估表明现有前沿模型在帮助用户构建偏好方面表现不佳。
ai_comments: 这篇论文切中了当前大模型和AI智能体落地中的一个重要痛点：用户往往“不知道自己不知道什么”，因而无法给出明确的偏好。文章创新性地引入了信息经济学中的“搜索-体验-信任”（SEC）框架来建模用户偏好的构建过程（CoPref），并开发了CoShop基准。其研究结论非常具有启发性，指出当前的智能体瓶颈不在于“寻找”物品，而在于“教育/引导”用户。局限性在于目前主要在推荐系统场景下进行了验证，未来可进一步拓展到更复杂的协作决策场景。
motivation: 现有的智能体通常假设用户是“专家用户”（即拥有明确、完善的偏好），并在任务不明确时默认进行澄清提问。然而，现实中用户往往缺乏领域知识来形成完全具体的偏好，导致无法回答智能体的偏好提问。因此，智能体需要帮助用户学习必要的领域知识以构建偏好。
method:
1. 借鉴信息经济学中的“搜索-体验-信任”（Search-Experience-Credence）框架，引入了CoPref模型，用于模拟用户如何根据智能体的对话行为构建偏好。
2. 在智能体推荐系统领域提出了一个名为CoShop的交互式基准，在其中智能体与CoPref用户进行对话并进行推荐，评估智能体能否帮助用户获取指定任务所需的知识。
results: 对五个前沿模型进行评估发现，尽管进行了五轮交互，但没有一个智能体在CoShop上的准确率超过56%。失败的原因不在于智能体寻找物品的能力，而在于交互过程中极少扩展用户对其需求的认知（即用户知道自己想要什么）。
conclusion: 智能体不能仅仅扮演偏好引导者的角色，而必须能够帮助用户构建偏好。当前的先进语言模型在这一任务上仍有很大的提升空间，未来的智能体交互设计需要更注重扩展用户的领域知识，而非仅仅进行简单的澄清提问。

title: GRay: Ray Tracing 3D Gaussians Near the Speed of Splats
authors: Yohan Poirier-Ginter, Jean-François Lalonde, George Drettakis
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a popular representation for radiance field reconstruction, distinguished by the rendering speed of its rasterization-based renderer. While 3D Gaussians can also be ray traced, this approach has so far been slower, with 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing (3DGRT) taking nearly one order of magnitude longer to optimize. To address this, we present GRay, a fast ray tracer for 3D Gaussians designed to close this performance gap and match 3DGS's speed. Our method leverages the algorithmic difference between both approaches: unlike rasterization, ray tracing evaluates only Gaussians that are actually intersected by a ray, leading to potentially logarithmic--rather than linear--scaling in the number of primitives. This property allows ray tracing to better exploit dense scenes composed of numerous tiny Gaussians, a configuration which has largely been overlooked. Notably, we show that dense initialization--which creates many small Gaussians--slows down rasterization, but instead speeds up ray tracing. Designed to leverage this effect, GRay renders nearly 4x faster and optimizes nearly 10x faster than 3DGRT while maintaining similar quality, and has competitive speed with 3DGS albeit at somewhat lower quality. Code is available at https://repo-sam.inria.fr/nerphys/gray.
comment: 12 pages plus supplementary material, 33 pages total; Proceedings of the ACM on Computer Graphics and Interactive Techniques, I3D 2026
zh_title: GRay：以接近 Splatting 的速度进行 3D 高斯光线追踪
translation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）是辐射场重建的一种流行表示方法，因其基于光栅化的渲染器的高效渲染速度而备受关注。虽然3D高斯也可以进行光线追踪，但迄今为止这种方法速度较慢，3D高斯光线追踪（3DGRT）需要多花近一个数量级的时间来进行优化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GRay，一种用于3D快速高斯的光线追踪器，旨在弥合这一性能差距并匹配3DGS的速度。我们的方法利用了两种方法之间的算法差异：与光栅化不同，光线追踪仅评估实际与光线相交的高斯函数，从而在基元数量上实现了潜在的对数级（而非线性级）缩放。这一特性使光线追踪能够更好地利用由大量微小高斯组成的稠密场景，而这种配置在很大程度上被忽视了。值得注意的是，我们展示了创建许多小高斯的稠密初始化会减慢光栅化，但反而会加速光线追踪。为了利用这种效应，GRay的设计在保持相似质量的同时，渲染速度比3DGRT快近4倍，优化速度快近10倍，并且具有与3DGS相当的速度，尽管质量略低。代码可在 https://repo-sam.inria.fr/nerphys/gray 获取。
tldr: GRay 通过利用光线追踪的对数级缩放特性和稠密初始化，将 3D 高斯光线追踪的渲染速度提升了 4 倍，优化速度提升了 10 倍，实现了接近 3DGS 的高运行效率。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地发现了“稠密初始化（产生大量微小高斯）”对光栅化（变慢）和光线追踪（变快）的相反影响，并以此设计了GRay，为3D高斯的光线追踪加速提供了全新的视角。其局限性在于图像质量相比 3DGS 略有下降。
motivation: 虽然 3D 高斯可以进行光线追踪，但现有的 3D 高斯光线追踪（3DGRT）优化速度极慢，比基于光栅化的 3DGS 慢了近一个数量级。本文旨在消除这一性能差距，实现与 3DGS 相当的运行速度。
method: 提出 GRay 方法，利用光线追踪仅评估与光线相交的高斯的特性（实现对数级而非线性级的复杂度缩放）。该方法采用稠密初始化策略，生成大量微小的高斯，从而在避开光栅化瓶颈的同时加速光线追踪。
results: GRay 的渲染速度比 3DGRT 快近 4 倍，优化速度快近 10 倍，且保持了相似的重建质量。此外，其运行速度可与 3DGS 媲美，尽管在重建质量上略逊一筹。
conclusion: GRay 成功缩小了 3D 高斯光线追踪与光栅化渲染之间的性能差距，证明了在由大量微小高斯组成的稠密场景中，光线追踪比光栅化更具扩展性优势。

title: The Label Imitation Game: Turing Test Network for Zero-Shot Pseudo-Label Pruning
authors: Brent A. Griffin, Jason J. Corso
abstract: Foundation model pseudo-labeling - labeling data strictly via zero-shot inference - enables massive scale, but performance is undermined by hallucinations that evade standard thresholds. To eliminate these errors, we introduce the Turing-inspired Label Imitation Game (LIG), a framework that formalizes pseudo-label pruning as an adversarial interrogation. Rather than filtering labels via isolated thresholds, we use the LIG to train a Turing Test Network (TTN), a task-agnostic "judge" that evaluates candidate pseudo-labels within a dataset-wide context. Experiments across four diverse datasets demonstrate the TTN's robustness, consistently enhancing label accuracy for three state-of-the-art vision-language models without costly supervision or retraining. Crucially, we demonstrate that learned semantic-contextual logic is a robust alternative to spatial-geometric verification, enabling a unique zero-shot task transfer capability - a TTN trained strictly on image classification datasets can effectively prune complex object detection pseudo-labels. This pruning yields F1-score gains of 28% for the worst-performing baseline categories and 44% with task-specific fine-tuning. Significantly, we also observe Category Revival, where the TTN pruning "detoxifies" the training signal for downstream models and enables them to recover from zero recall on transfer-vulnerable classes. The pre-trained TTN models and code are available at https://github.com/voxel51/ttn.
zh_title: 标签模仿游戏：用于零样本伪标签剪枝的图灵测试网络
translation: 基础模型伪标签技术——完全通过零样本推理来标注数据——能够实现大规模应用，但其性能受到避开标准阈值的幻觉错误的削弱。为了消除这些错误，我们引入了受图灵启发的标签模仿游戏（LIG），这是一个将伪标签剪枝形式化为对抗性审问的框架。我们没有通过孤立的阈值来过滤标签，而是使用LIG来训练一个图灵测试网络（TTN），这是一个任务无关的“裁判”，用于在数据集全局上下文中评估候选伪标签。在四个不同数据集上的实验证明了TTN的鲁棒性，在没有昂贵的监督或重新训练的情况下，持续提高了三种最先进视觉语言模型的标签准确率。关键是，我们证明了学习到的语义上下文逻辑是空间几何验证的一种鲁棒替代方案，从而实现了一种独特的零样本任务迁移能力——严格在图像分类数据集上训练的TTN可以有效剪枝复杂的目标检测伪标签。这种剪枝使表现最差的基线类别的F1分数提高了28%，在进行特定任务微调时提高了44%。值得注意的是，我们还观察到了“类别复苏”现象，即TTN剪枝为下游模型的训练信号“解毒”，使它们能够从迁移脆弱类别上的零召回率中恢复过来。预训练的TTN模型和代码可在 https://github.com/voxel51/ttn 获取。
tldr: 本文提出了一种受图灵测试启发的标签模仿游戏（LIG）和图灵测试网络（TTN），通过全局上下文评估和对抗审问机制剪枝伪标签，实现了强大的跨任务零样本迁移与标签去噪能力。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将图灵测试的思想引入到伪标签过滤中，将传统的静态阈值筛选转化为对抗性审问机制，视角独特。其最大的亮点在于实现了出色的零样本跨任务迁移能力（仅在分类任务上训练的TTN可直接用于目标检测伪标签剪枝），证明了语义上下文逻辑在处理幻觉标签时的强大泛化性。局限性在于，摘要中未详细提及TTN自身训练所需的资源消耗以及在更极端分布漂移下的表现。
motivation: 利用基础模型进行零样本伪标签标注虽然能实现大规模数据处理，但其性能常常受到“幻觉”错误的干扰，且这些错误极易规避传统的单一阈值过滤方法。
method: 引入了受图灵启发的“标签模仿游戏（LIG）”框架，将伪标签剪枝定义为对抗性审问。利用该框架训练一个任务无关的“图灵测试网络（TTN）”作为裁判，在数据集的全局上下文中评估候选伪标签，利用学习到的语义上下文逻辑代替传统的空间几何验证。
results: 在四个数据集上，TTN一致提升了三种先进视觉语言模型的标签准确率。仅在图像分类数据集上训练的TTN可成功剪枝复杂的目标检测伪标签，使最差基线类别的F1分数提升28%（特定微调后提升44%）。此外，TTN剪枝还能通过“解毒”下游模型的训练信号，实现“类别复苏”，使其从零召回率中恢复。
conclusion: 图灵测试网络（TTN）为解决基础模型伪标签中的幻觉问题提供了一种高效、鲁棒且具备跨任务零样本迁移能力的通用解决方案，无需重训或高昂监督，即可显著改善下游模型的训练质量。

title: Vector alignment in matrix Lie groups
authors: Congzhou M Sha
abstract: The difference in gauge between two observers of the same physical system can be thought of as a group element acting on their common vector representations. Recovering that group element from a finite, noisy list of paired observations may be of use in both theory and experiment. The Kabsch and Horn algorithms efficiently align point clouds in $\mathbb R^3$, reconciling rotated frames of reference in Galilean relativity (i.e. $SO(3)$). In a previous work, we proposed an alternative Lie algebra method which extends to the Lorentz group $SO(3,1)_+$, and putatively to all Lie groups. In this work, we report the explicit formulae for applying the Lie algebra method to the classical matrix Lie groups (general linear $GL(n)$, special linear $SL(n)$, special orthogonal $SO(n)$, unitary $U(n)$, indefinite special orthogonal $SO(p,q)$, symplectic $Sp(n)$, spin $Spin(n)$, special Euclidean $SE(n)$) over both the real and complex fields. The four steps (pseudoinverse, matrix logarithm, projection onto the Lie algebra, matrix exponential) are exact in the noiseless case. The only group-dependent step is the projection, which we show produces the unique least squares-optimal element of the Lie algebra whenever its image lies in $\mathfrak g$ and its residual is orthogonal to $\mathfrak g$. Additionally, the Lie algebra method is optimal only to leading order for noisy data, so we refine it with a Newton-style correction. This correction matches the Lie algebra method in the noiseless case and direct least squares optimization in the noisy case, with performance between that of the Lie algebra method without correction and naive least squares optimization. The projections, their optimality, and the identity underlying the correction are formally proven in Lean~4.31.0 (with Mathlib 4.31.0), and numerical experiments are benchmarked in Julia.
zh_title: 矩阵李群中的向量对齐
translation: 同一物理系统的两个观测者之间的规范（gauge）差异可以被视为作用于其共同向量表示上的群元素。从有限且含有噪声的配对观测列表中恢复该群元素在理论和实验中都可能有用。Kabsch 和 Horn 算法可以高效地对齐 $\mathbb R^3$ 中的点云，从而协调伽利略相对论中的旋转参考系（即 $SO(3)$）。在之前的工作中，我们提出了一种替代的李代数方法，该方法可推广到洛伦兹群 $SO(3,1)_+$，并推定可推广到所有李群。在这项工作中，我们报告了将该李代数方法应用于实数域和复数域上的经典矩阵李群（一般线性群 $GL(n)$、特殊线性群 $SL(n)$、特殊正交群 $SO(n)$、酉群 $U(n)$、不定特殊正交群 $SO(p,q)$、辛群 $Sp(n)$、自旋群 $Spin(n)$、特殊欧几里得群 $SE(n)$）的显式公式。这四个步骤（伪逆、矩阵对数、投影 onto 李代数、矩阵指数）在无噪声情况下是精确的。唯一与群相关的步骤是投影，我们证明了只要其像落在 $\mathfrak g$ 中且其残差与 $\mathfrak g$ 正交，该投影就会产生李代数中唯一的最小二乘最优元素。此外，李代数方法仅在含噪数据的一阶意义下是最优的，因此我们使用牛顿式修正对其进行了改进。这种修正结合了无噪情况下的李代数方法和有噪情况下的直接最小二乘优化，其性能介于无修正的李代数方法和朴素最小二乘优化之间。投影、它们的最优性以及修正背后的恒等式已在 Lean 4.31.0（结合 Mathlib 4.31.0）中得到了形式化证明，并且数值实验在 Julia 中进行了基准测试。
tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于经典矩阵李群的向量对齐李代数方法，引入牛顿式修正以提高含噪数据下的性能，并在 Lean 中对算法的最优性进行了形式化证明。
ai_comments: 本文的创新之处在于将传统的向量对齐问题（如 $SO(3)$ 上的 Kabsch 算法）成功推广到了更广泛的经典矩阵李群（包括实域和复域上的 $GL(n)$, $SL(n)$, $SO(p,q)$ 等）。其最大亮点在于不仅提出了算法和牛顿式修正，还使用定理证明器 Lean 4.31.0 对投影的数学最优性进行了形式化证明，这在计算几何和数学物理领域提供了极高的理论严谨性。不过，该方法在面临极端高噪声数据时的鲁棒性可能仍需在具体物理实验中进一步检验。
motivation: 在物理系统中，不同观测者之间的规范（gauge）差异可表示为作用于其向量表示上的群元素。如何从有限且含有噪声的配对观测数据中恢复该群元素（即向量对齐问题）在理论和实验中都具有重要意义。现有的 Kabsch 和 Horn 算法仅适用于 $SO(3)$，需要一种能推广到更一般李群的通用方法。
method: 提出了一种包含四个步骤（伪逆、矩阵对数、投影到李代数、矩阵指数）的李代数对齐方法，并推导出了适用于多种经典矩阵李群的显式投影公式。针对含噪数据，引入了牛顿式修正（Newton-style correction）来优化一阶李代数方法。此外，使用 Lean 4.31.0 形式化证明了投影的最优性，并在 Julia 中进行了数值基准测试。
results: 在无噪声情况下，所提李代数方法的四个步骤是精确的，其投影步骤在特定条件下能产生唯一的最小二乘最优李代数元素。在含噪情况下，引入的牛顿式修正性能介于未修正的李代数方法和朴素最小二乘优化之间，且在无噪和含噪的极限情况下分别与两者相匹配。相关数学定理已在 Lean 中得到完整证明。
conclusion: 该研究为经典矩阵李群中的向量对齐提供了一套通用的李代数框架，并通过牛顿式修正解决了噪声干扰问题。其数学正确性通过 Lean 得到了形式化验证，数值实验也证实了其有效性。

title: A Systematic Approach to Multi-Agent AI from Advanced Regulatory Control Theory: Safe and Auditable LLM Operator Agents for Process Control
authors: Idelfonso B. R. Nogueira, Sigurd Skogestad
abstract: Recent literature shows that large language models (LLMs) are useful for general-purpose tasks yet perform poorly on specific domain ones. One reason is the difficulty of supplying narrow context to a general-purpose model and of bounding the task it is asked to perform. It is possible to hypothesise that a multi-agent reformulation under process-control principles offers a route to address those points, since control theory provides a discipline of decomposing a system into elements of contained scope, each defending one controlled variable, with conflicts resolved by structural priority: MIN/MAX selector networks for CV-CV switching and split-range (split-parallel) logic for MV-MV switching. The present work proposes such a reformulation, derived from Advanced Regulatory Control (ARC) theory. Each feedback loop in the ARC chain is mapped to one specialised LLM operator agent carrying the loop's control-theoretic context (controlled variable, setpoint, chain priority, selector kind). The chain's interaction logic (MIN/MAX selectors, override paths) is encapsulated as a single orchestrator agent. Two orchestrator variants are tested: a deterministic rule chain, and a Claude-based LLM orchestrator at a slower tier. The control principles limit each agent's task and inform how its limitations are handled. The multi-agent system inherits the safety property of the ARC chain: every constraint conflict is resolved deterministically by the orchestrator, regardless of the LLM output. Evaluated on a dairy-barn ventilation case over a 4-day mixed-season scenario, Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct operator agents running offline on a 24 GB consumer GPU at a 5-minute cadence produce auditable trajectories, each paired with an operator-voice rationale that supports a control campaign logbook.
zh_title: 基于高级常规控制理论的多智能体AI系统化方法：用于过程控制的安全且可审计的LLM操作员智能体
translation: 最近的文献表明，大型语言模型（LLM）在通用任务中非常有用，但在特定领域任务中表现不佳。原因之一是难以向通用模型提供狭窄的上下文并限制其被要求执行的任务。可以假设，在过程控制原则下进行多智能体重新表述提供了一条解决这些问题的途径，因为控制理论提供了一种将系统分解为包含范围的元素的学科，每个元素防御一个受控变量，并通过结构优先级解决冲突：用于CV-CV切换的MIN/MAX选择器网络和用于MV-MV切换的分程（分程并行）逻辑。本工作提出了一种源自高级常规控制（ARC）理论的此类重新表述。ARC链中的每个反馈回路都被映射到一个专用的LLM操作员智能体，该智能体携带该回路的控制论上下文（受控变量、设定值、链优先级、选择器类型）。链的交互逻辑（MIN/MAX选择器、超驰路径）被封装为一个单一的编排器智能体。测试了两种编排器变体：确定性规则链和较慢层级的基于Claude的LLM编排器。控制原则限制了每个智能体的任务，并告知了如何处理其局限性。该多智能体系统继承了ARC链的安全属性：无论LLM输出如何，每个约束冲突都由编排器确定性地解决。在为期4天的混季奶牛场通风案例上进行了评估，在24 GB消费级GPU上以5分钟步长离线运行的Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct操作员智能体产生了可审计的轨迹，每条轨迹都与支持控制活动日志的操作员语音合理解释相匹配。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合高级常规控制（ARC）理论的多智能体LLM框架，通过将控制回路映射为专用智能体并使用确定性编排器解决冲突，实现了安全、可审计且能在消费级GPU上离线运行的过程控制系统。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将经典的高级常规控制（ARC）理论与现代多智能体LLM相结合，利用控制理论的确定性结构来约束LLM的行为，从而保证了物理系统的安全性。其重要性在于为LLM在工业控制等高安全要求领域的应用提供了一种可行且可审计的架构。局限性在于目前仅在奶牛场通风这一特定且相对简单的案例上进行了离线评估，其在更复杂、高频的工业实时控制中的表现和泛化能力仍有待验证。
motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在通用任务中表现出色，但在特定领域任务中表现不佳，原因在于难以向通用模型提供狭窄的上下文并限制其任务范围。作者假设利用过程控制原则（如控制理论的分离和优先级机制）进行多智能体重新表述可以解决这一问题。
method: 提出一种基于高级常规控制（ARC）理论的多智能体框架。将ARC链中的每个反馈回路映射到一个专用的LLM操作员智能体（携带受控变量、设定值等上下文），并由一个单独的编排器智能体（测试了确定性规则链和基于Claude的LLM编排器两种版本）来封装链的交互逻辑（如MIN/MAX选择器和超驰路径），从而确保冲突的确定性解决。
results: 在奶牛场通风案例（4天混季场景）的评估中，使用24 GB消费级GPU离线运行的Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct操作员智能体（5分钟步长）能够产生可审计的控制轨迹，并为每条轨迹提供支持控制日志的操作员合理解释。
conclusion: 该多智能体系统成功继承了ARC链的安全属性，确保所有约束冲突均能由编排器确定性地解决，不受LLM随机输出的影响，为过程控制提供了一种安全、受限且可审计的LLM部署方案。

title: Neural Signatures of Programming Expertise: Classifying Programmer Skill Levels Using EEG Data
authors: Maurice Rekrut, Mahima Mahabaleshwar Acharya, Taisiia Ulianova, Norman Peitek, Annabelle Bergum, Mariya Toneva, Sven Apel, Antonio Krüger
abstract: Accurately assessing a programmer's skill level is critical for hiring, team composition, and performance evaluation in the software industry. Conventional methods, such as coding tests or interviews, often fail to capture the full spectrum of cognitive abilities underlying programming expertise. This study explores using electroencephalography (EEG) and machine learning to investigate neural correlates of programming skill. We analyzed an existing EEG dataset recorded during code comprehension from 37 programmers with 1 to 30 years of experience (8.1 +/- 6.3 years) to examine relationships between neural activity and expertise. Additionally, we conducted classification experiments using Random Forest classifiers with diverse features for binary (experts vs. novices) and multi-class (experts, intermediates, novices) setups.We identified EEG features and brain regions associated with programming expertise. Specifically, EEG entropy showed the strongest correlation with skill level. Furthermore, experts' brains were characterized by highly localized centro-frontal activation, whereas frontal activation in other groups was part of a more distributed network. Regarding classification, our setup achieved an average accuracy of 91.83% (binary) and 78.15% (multi-class) in stratified 10-fold cross-validation, while leave-one-subject-out validation achieved 85.00% and 58.80%, respectively. Individual frequency bands outperformed full-spectrum analyses, and both program comprehension and resting-state data yielded strong results. These findings demonstrate that EEG features effectively capture neural correlates across different skill levels and highlight the potential of neural data to complement traditional methods of skill assessment.
zh_title: 编程专业能力的神经特征：利用脑电图（EEG）数据对程序员技能水平进行分类
translation: 准确评估程序员的技能水平对于软件行业的招聘、团队组建和绩效评估至关重要。传统的评估方法（如编程测试或面试）往往无法全面捕获编程专业能力背后的完整认知能力。本研究探讨了利用脑电图（EEG）和机器学习来研究编程技能的神经关联。我们分析了37名具有1至30年经验（平均8.1 +/- 6.3年）的程序员在代码理解过程中记录的现有EEG数据集，以检验神经活动与专业能力之间的关系。此外，我们使用随机森林分类器，结合多种特征，针对二分类（专家与新手）和多分类（专家、中等、新手）设置进行了分类实验。我们识别出了与编程专业能力相关的EEG特征和脑区。具体而言，EEG熵与技能水平的相关性最强。此外，专家的脑部特征表现为高度局限的中央-额叶激活，而其他组的额叶激活则是更分散网络的一部分。在分类方面，我们的设置在分层10折交叉验证中实现了91.83%（二分类）和78.15%（多分类）的平均准确率，而在留一法验证中分别实现了85.00%和58.80%的准确率。单个频段的表现优于全光谱分析，且程序理解和静息态数据均取得了优异的结果。这些发现表明，EEG特征能够有效捕获不同技能水平的神经关联，并突显了神经数据在补充传统技能评估方法方面的潜力。
tldr: 本研究利用脑电图（EEG）和随机森林分类器，通过分析程序员的脑电特征（如脑电熵和特定脑区激活），实现了对程序员技能水平的高精度分类（二分类准确率达91.83%），展示了神经生理数据在评估编程能力方面的潜力。
ai_comments: 本文将认知神经科学（EEG）与软件工程评估相结合，提出了一种基于生理信号的程序员技能分类方法，具有很强的跨学科创新性。研究发现脑电熵是关键特征，且专家大脑激活更具局限性，这些发现对理解编程认知过程有重要价值。然而，留一法（LOSO）在多分类任务中的准确率仅为58.80%，表明模型在跨个体泛化上仍存在局限，且37人的样本量相对较小。
motivation: 传统的程序员技能评估方法（如代码测试和面试）无法全面捕捉编程专业知识背后的复杂认知能力，因此需要一种更客观、能反映大脑认知状态的神经生理评估方法。
method: 研究分析了37名程序员（经验在1至30年之间）在代码理解期间的EEG数据集。使用随机森林分类器，提取多样化脑电特征，针对二分类（专家 vs. 新手）和多分类（专家、中级、新手）任务进行分类实验，并采用10折交叉验证和留一法（leave-one-subject-out）进行评估。
results: 1. EEG熵与编程技能水平的相关性最强；2. 专家的脑部激活表现为高度局限的中央-额叶激活，而其他组则表现为更分散的额叶网络；3. 在10折交叉验证中，二分类和多分类准确率分别达到91.83%和78.15%；在留一法验证中分别为85.00%和58.80%；4. 单频段分析优于全谱分析，且程序理解和静息态数据均表现出良好的分类效果。
conclusion: EEG特征能够有效捕捉不同编程技能水平的神经关联，表明脑电等神经数据在补充和改进传统软件行业技能评估方法上具有巨大的应用潜力。

title: Algorithms and complexity for geodetic sets on interval and chordal graphs
authors: Dibyayan Chakraborty, Sandip Das, Florent Foucaud, Harmender Gahlawat, Dimitri Lajou
abstract: We study the computational complexity of finding the geodetic number of a graph on chordal graphs and interval graphs. A set $S$ of vertices of a graph $G$ is a \textit{geodetic set} if every vertex of $G$ lies in a shortest path between some pair of vertices of $S$. The \textsc{Minimum Geodetic Set (MGS)} problem is to find a geodetic set with minimum cardinality of a given graph. We show that \textsc{Minimum Geodetic Set} is fixed parameter tractable for chordal graphs when parameterized by its \emph{tree-width} (which equals its clique number). This implies a polynomial-time algorithm for $k$-trees, for fixed $k$. Then, we show that \textsc{Minimum Geodetic Set} is NP-hard on interval graphs, thereby answering a question of Ekim et al. (LATIN, 2012), who showed that \textsc{Minimum Geodetic Set} is polynomial-time solvable on proper interval graphs. As interval graphs are very constrained, to prove the latter result, we design a rather sophisticated reduction technique to work around their inherent linear structure.
comment: This manuscript corresponds to one part of the original ISAAC 2020 conference paper (Algorithms and Complexity for Geodetic Sets on Planar and Chordal Graphs). During journal revision, the conference version was split into two independent and disjoint journal articles. This arXiv version matches the article published in InC. The other part appeared in TCS. The author list has also changed
zh_title: 区间图和弦图上测地集的算法与复杂度
translation: 我们研究了在弦图和区间图上寻找图的测地数（geodetic number）的计算复杂度。图 $G$ 的一个顶点子集 $S$ 如果满足 $G$ 的每个顶点都位于 $S$ 中某对顶点之间的最短路径上，则称 $S$ 为一个测地集（geodetic set）。最小测地集（MGS）问题是寻找给定图的基数最小的测地集。我们证明了，当以树宽（等于其团数）为参数时，最小测地集问题在弦图上是固定参数可解的。这意味着对于固定的 $k$，存在针对 $k$-树的多项式时间算法。接着，我们证明了最小测地集问题在区间图上是NP-难的，从而回答了Ekim等人（LATIN, 2012）提出的一个问题，他们曾证明了最小测地集问题在真区间图上是多项式时间可解的。由于区间图具有很强的约束性，为了证明后一个结果，我们设计了一种相当复杂的归约技术，以克服其固有的线性结构。
keywords: 固定参数可解性 (Fixed Parameter Tractability)
tldr: 本文证明了弦图上的最小测地集（MGS）问题关于树宽是固定参数可解（FPT）的，并证明了该问题在区间图上是NP-难的，解答了一个公开问题。
ai_comments: 本文在图论算法与复杂度领域做出了重要贡献。其创新性主要体现在两方面：一是通过将树宽作为参数，证明了弦图上最小测地集（MGS）问题的固定参数可解性（FPT）；二是通过设计一种极其精妙且复杂的归约技术，克服了区间图固有的线性结构限制，证明了MGS在区间图上的NP-难解性。这一结果不仅解答了Ekim等人（2012年）提出的公开问题，也为在具有强线性约束的图类上证明NP-难解性提供了有价值的归约思路。
motivation: 探究在弦图和区间图上寻找图的测地数（geodetic number）的计算复杂度。特别是为了解决Ekim等人（LATIN, 2012）提出的一个公开问题，即最小测地集（MGS）问题在区间图上的计算复杂度（已知在真区间图上是多项式时间可解的）。
method:
1. 针对弦图，采用参数化复杂度分析方法，以树宽（等同于团数）为参数，证明了该问题是固定参数可解的（FPT），并推导出固定 $k$ 的 $k$-树的多项式时间算法。
2. 针对区间图，设计了一种精妙且复杂的归约技术（reduction technique），以克服区间图固有的线性结构约束，从而完成了NP-难解性的证明。
results:
1. 证明了以树宽为参数时，弦图上的最小测地集（MGS）问题是固定参数可解的（FPT）。
2. 证明了区间图上的MGS问题是NP-难的，成功回答了Ekim等人的公开提问。
conclusion: 本文成功界定了最小测地集（MGS）问题在弦图和区间图上的复杂度边界。在弦图上，该问题关于树宽是固定参数可解的；而在区间图上，该问题则是NP-难的。这一结论完善了特殊图类上测地集问题的计算复杂度理论。

title: Automated Reasoning with Nested Datatypes
authors: Tomer Hakak, Yoni Zohar, Andrew Reynolds, Clark Barrett, Cesare Tinelli
abstract:
We introduce a theory of nested datatypes. The theory is obtained
  by restricting the naive combination of datatypes and arrays, so as to prevent
  non-standard models from emerging.
  A decision procedure for the theory is given and proven correct.
  Finally, we describe an implementation of the procedure,
  as well as an evaluation over both real-world and crafted benchmarks.
zh_title: 嵌套数据类型的自动推理
translation: 我们引入了一种嵌套数据类型理论。该理论通过限制数据类型和数组的朴素组合而获得，以防止非标准模型的出现。我们给出了该理论的一个决策过程并证明其正确性。最后，我们描述了该过程的实现，以及在真实世界和人工构建的基准上的评估。
tldr: 引入了一种嵌套数据类型理论，通过限制数据类型和数组的组合来防止非标准模型，并给出了一个经过验证的决策过程及其实现和评估。
ai_comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个受限的嵌套数据类型理论，解决了数据类型与数组组合时可能出现的非标准模型问题。其决策过程的正确性证明和实际评估增强了其可靠性和实用性。
motivation: 防止数据类型与数组的朴素组合中出现非标准模型。
method: 引入了一个受限的嵌套数据类型理论，并为此理论提供了一个决策过程，证明其正确性，然后实现了该过程并在实际和人工基准上进行了评估。
results: 提出了一个经过验证的决策过程，并描述了其实现以及在实际和人工基准上的评估。
conclusion: 提出的嵌套数据类型理论及其决策过程能够有效防止非标准模型，并已通过实现和评估得到验证。

title: Training Therapeutic Judges and Multi-Agent Systems for Human-Aligned Mental Health Support
authors: Mizanur Rahman, Abeer Badawi, Elahe Rahimi, Laleh Seyyed-Kalantari, Frank Rudzicz, Enamul Hoque, Elham Dolatabadi
abstract: Large language models show promise for mental health support, yet therapeutic quality improves only when evaluation functions as an actionable control signal rather than a passive metric. We introduce a framework that formulates therapeutic response generation as a decision-refinement problem driven by multi-dimensional, human-aligned evaluation. In Stage I, we introduce TheraJudge, an open-source therapeutic evaluator trained via preference-based optimization on human-annotated data to produce reliable judgments across 7 psychological dimensions. In Stage II, we introduce TheraAgent, which operationalizes TheraJudge's evaluations through a coordinated refinement process with specialized Critic, Coach, and Therapist roles that translate evaluative signals into targeted response revisions. Empirically, TheraJudge achieves strong agreement with clinician ratings, with intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC = 0.87-0.95), surpassing supervised baselines and strong closed-source judges, particularly on critical dimensions such as Safety, Relevance, and Empathy. Acting on these evaluations, TheraAgent yields a +0.43 improvement in human-rated therapeutic quality (on a 5-point scale) under blind evaluation, with 96\% clinician inter-rater reliability. Low-quality responses ($\leq 3$) improve by +2.45 points with a 94\% recovery rate, demonstrating targeted correction of unsafe outputs. Overall, our results indicate that effective alignment of mental-health LLMs stems from acting on human-aligned evaluation, rather than relying solely on stronger generation. We release code at https://github.com/vis-nlp/TheraAlign.
zh_title: 训练治疗性评估器与多智能体系统以实现符合人类标准的心理健康支持
translation: 大语言模型在心理健康支持方面展现出前景，但只有当评估作为一种可执行的控制信号而非被动度量指标时，治疗质量才能得到提升。我们介绍了一个将治疗性回复生成公式化为由多维度、符合人类标准的评估所驱动的决策细化问题的框架。在第一阶段，我们引入了 TheraJudge，这是一个开源的治疗评估器，通过在人类标注数据上进行基于偏好优化的训练，能够在 7 个心理学维度上产生可靠的判断。在第二阶段，我们引入了 TheraAgent，它通过由专门的批判者（Critic）、教练（Coach）和治疗师（Therapist）角色组成的协调细化过程，将 TheraJudge 的评估信号转化为针对性的回复修正。实验表明，TheraJudge 与临床医生的评分具有很强的一致性（组内相关系数 ICC = 0.87-0.95），超越了监督基线和强闭源评估器，特别是在安全性、相关性和共情等关键维度上。在这些评估的基础上，TheraAgent 在盲测评估中使人类评分的治疗质量提高了 +0.43 分（5 分制），临床医生评分者间信度达 96%。低质量回复（≤ 3）提高了 +2.45 分，恢复率达到 94%，展示了对不安全输出的针对性纠正。总体而言，我们的结果表明，心理健康大语言模型的有效对齐源于对符合人类标准的评估采取行动，而不是仅仅依赖更强大的生成能力。我们在 https://github.com/vis-nlp/TheraAlign 开源了代码。
tldr: 本文提出了一个双阶段框架：先训练多维度心理评估器 TheraJudge，再通过多智能体系统 TheraAgent（含批判者、教练、治疗师角色）将评估信号转化为针对性的回复修正，显著提升了心理健康支持的质量与安全性。
ai_comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将心理健康支持回复的生成视为一个由多维度评估驱动的“决策-细化”动态修正过程，而非单次生成。通过引入多智能体角色（批判者、教练、治疗师）来协同消费评估信号，提供了一种新颖且可落地的LLM对齐和安全性控制方案。然而，多智能体多轮协作可能会带来较高的推理延迟和计算成本，在需要极高实时性的在线心理咨询场景中的可行性仍需进一步探讨。
motivation: 大语言模型在心理健康支持方面具有潜力，但现有的评估往往只作为被动的度量指标。只有当评估能够作为一种“可执行的控制信号”来指导回复的修正时，治疗质量才能得到真正提升。
method:
提出一个将治疗性回复生成公式化为由多维度、符合人类标准的评估所驱动的决策细化框架，分为两个阶段：
1. **第一阶段（TheraJudge）**：引入一个开源的治疗评估器，通过在人类标注数据上进行基于偏好优化的训练，在安全、相关、共情等7个心理学维度上生成可靠的评估。
2. **第二阶段（TheraAgent）**：引入一个多智能体系统，通过协调专门的批判者（Critic）、教练（Coach）和治疗师（Therapist）角色，将 TheraJudge 的评估信号转化为具体的回复修改。
results:
1. **TheraJudge** 与临床医生评分表现出高度一致性（ICC = 0.87-0.95），在安全性、相关性和共情等关键维度上超越了监督基线和强闭源评估器。
2. **TheraAgent** 在双盲评估中使人类评分的治疗质量提升了 +0.43（5分制），临床医生评分者间信度达 96%。
3. **安全性纠正**：低质量回复（≤ 3分）在修正后评分提升了 +2.45 分，恢复率达 94%，有效纠正了不安全的输出。
conclusion: 心理健康领域大语言模型的有效对齐，关键在于能够对符合人类标准的评估信号采取针对性的修正行动，而不仅仅是依赖更强大的单次生成能力。

title: Debugging as Evidence-Driven Reasoning: Visualization Opportunities in Data-Intensive Programming
authors: Yongbo Chen, Yan Zhu, Rebecca Faust
abstract: Visualization has been recognized as a valuable means of supporting debugging by externalizing runtime behavior that would otherwise remain hidden or scattered. However, most visual debugging research has focused on traditional software development settings, leaving the distinct challenges of data-intensive workflows largely uncharacterized. To build visual debugging support for these settings, we first need to characterize how practitioners debug in these settings and translate their challenges into concrete visualization opportunities. To this end, we conducted semi-structured interviews with nine participants from diverse data-intensive domains and analyzed the data using thematic analysis. Our analysis reveals three cross-cutting challenge: assembling fragmented evidence, detecting expected-observed discrepancies, and tracing state evolution across workflow components. We distill these challenges into three concrete requirements that current debuggers support only partially but that visualization is well suited to address: cross-artifact evidence alignment, expectation-grounded comparison, and traceable state evolution. Together, these requirements begin to characterize a design space for future visual debugging research in data-intensive programming.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, submitted to IEEE VIS conference
zh_title: 调试即证据驱动的推理：数据密集型编程中的可视化契机
translation: 可视化已被公认为是支持调试的一种有价值的手段，它能够将原本处于隐藏或分散状态的运行时行为外显化。然而，大多数可视化调试研究都集中在传统的软件开发场景中，这使得数据密集型工作流的独特挑战在很大程度上尚未得到刻画。为了在这些场景中构建可视化调试支持，我们首先需要刻画从业者在这些场景中是如何进行调试的，并将他们的挑战转化为具体的可视化机会。为此，我们对来自不同数据密集型领域的九名参与者进行了半结构化访谈，并使用主题分析法对数据进行了分析。我们的分析揭示了三个具有交叉性的挑战：整合碎片化证据、检测预期与实际观察到的差异，以及跨工作流组件追踪状态演变。我们将这些挑战提炼为当前调试器仅能部分支持、但可视化非常适合解决的三个具体需求：跨制品证据对齐、基于预期的对比以及可追溯的状态演变。这些需求共同开始刻画出未来数据密集型编程中可视化调试研究的设计空间。
tldr: 本研究通过访谈调查了数据密集型编程中的调试挑战，提出了三个关键的可视化调试需求，为未来的可视化调试工具设计指明了方向。
ai_comments: 本研究的创新之处在于将数据密集型编程的调试过程建模为“证据驱动的推理”，并填补了传统可视化调试研究与数据密集型工作流之间的空白。其重要性在于为未来针对数据科学、机器学习等领域的调试工具开发提供了具体的设计空间和需求框架。局限性在于访谈样本量较小（仅9位参与者），可能无法完全覆盖所有数据密集型子领域的独特调试痛点。
motivation: 虽然可视化在传统软件调试中已被证明非常有效，但数据密集型工作流中的独特调试挑战尚未得到系统刻画。为了开发适用于这些场景的可视化调试工具，需要首先理解从业者是如何进行调试的，并将其挑战转化为具体的可视化设计契机。
method: 对来自不同数据密集型领域的9名从业者进行了半结构化访谈，并使用主题分析法（thematic analysis）对访谈数据进行了定性分析。
results: 分析揭示了三大核心挑战：整合碎片化证据、检测预期与观察到的差异、以及跨工作流组件追踪状态演变。研究进一步将这些挑战转化为当前调试器支持不足、但极适合可视化解决的三个具体需求：跨制品证据对齐、基于预期的对比以及可追溯的状态演变。
conclusion: 这些提炼出的需求（跨制品证据对齐、基于预期的对比、可追溯的状态演变）共同构成了未来数据密集型编程可视化调试研究的设计空间。

title: Sampling-Based Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning
authors: Antonio Marino, Esteban Restrepo, Soon-jo Chung, Paolo Robuffo Giordano, Claudio Pacchierotti
abstract: Multi-robot systems must simultaneously optimize competing objectives while maintaining coordinated behavior. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches often rely on fixed or centralized coordination, which limits adaptability and violates distributed constraints. This work introduces the Coordination-Informed Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (CIMORL) framework, integrating a distributed weight prediction mechanism, a privileged expert training strategy, and theoretical guarantees for Pareto-optimal solutions. We present the base CIMORL method alongside two sampling-based variants, CIMORL-TS (Tree Search) and CIMORL-MPPI (MPPI), which leverage privileged global information during training to enable fully decentralized deployment. Experimental validation in cooperative and adversarial scenarios demonstrates a $21.2\%$ hypervolume improvement and superior policy stability compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Real-world experiments with Crazyflie drones further validate the framework's robustness in resource allocation and multi-attacker multi-defend scenarios under partial observability.
zh_title: 基于采样的协调知情多目标多机器人强化学习
translation: 多机器人系统必须在保持协调行为的同时，优化相互竞争的多个目标。现有的多智能体强化学习方法通常依赖于固定或集中的协调，这限制了适应性并违反了分布式约束。本工作引入了协调知情多目标强化学习（CIMORL）框架，该框架集成了分布式权重预测机制、特权专家训练策略以及帕累托最优解的理论保证。我们提出了基础的CIMORL方法以及两种基于采样的变体，CIMORL-TS（树搜索）和CIMORL-MPPI（模型预测路径积分），它们在训练期间利用特权全局信息，以实现完全去中心化的部署。在合作和对抗场景中的实验验证表明，与最先进的基线方法相比，该方法实现了21.2%的超体积提升和更优的策略稳定性。使用Crazyflie无人机进行的真实世界实验进一步验证了该框架在部分可观测情况下的资源分配和多攻击者-多防御者场景中的鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种CIMORL框架及其基于采样的变体，通过在训练中引入特权全局信息，实现了多机器人系统在完全去中心化部署下的多目标优化与协调，实验表明其超体积指标提升了21.2%并具有极强的真机鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多目标强化学习与多机器人协调相结合，通过“训练时集中（使用特权信息）、部署时去中心化”的思路，有效解决了多机器人系统在多目标优化中的分布式约束问题。引入基于采样的树搜索（CIMORL-TS）和MPPI（CIMORL-MPPI）变体，增强了其在复杂、部分可观测场景下的决策能力。高达21.2%的超体积提升以及在真实Crazyflie无人机上的成功部署，充分证明了该方法的实用价值和鲁棒性。
motivation: 多机器人系统在维持协调行为的同时，需要优化多个相互竞争的目标。现有的多智能体强化学习方法通常依赖于固定或集中的协调机制，这限制了系统的适应性，且违反了分布式部署的约束。
method: 提出了协调知情多目标强化学习（CIMORL）框架，集成了分布式权重预测机制、特权专家训练策略，并提供了帕累托最优解的理论保证。同时，设计了两种基于采样的变体：CIMORL-TS（树搜索）和CIMORL-MPPI（模型预测路径积分），在训练阶段利用特权全局信息，以实现完全去中心化的实际部署。
results: 在合作和对抗场景的实验中，该方法相比于最先进的基线方法实现了21.2%的超体积（hypervolume）提升，并展现出更优的策略稳定性。此外，在Crazyflie无人机上的真实世界实验也验证了该框架在部分可观测下的资源分配和多攻击者-多防御者场景中的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 本文提出的CIMORL框架及其基于采样的变体，能够有效解决多机器人系统中的多目标优化与协调问题，在保证完全去中心化部署的同时，提供了帕累托最优保证，具有极高的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: Knowledge-Driven Dimension Estimation from a Single Image -3D Asset Generation Technology for Digital Twin Construction
authors: Hidenori Sakaniwa, Akihito Akai, Akihiko Hyodo
abstract: In the verification of in-vehicle cameras, simulation technology using virtual spaces has advanced, enabling pre-evaluation of false detections and missed detections in various scenarios. However, discrepancies in the scale of the object being verified between the virtual and real environments can lead to a decrease in camera recognition performance. For traffic signs installed at high altitudes, distance measurement using LiDAR or stereo cameras is difficult, requiring size estimation from monocular images. This paper proposes a method for estimating the scale of an object by decomposing it into multiple structural elements and integrating external knowledge regarding design rules, geometric relationships, and conventional dimensions. Specifically, this method detects each component from a monocular image and estimates the size of each component by considering its structural relationships and dimensional consistency with surrounding elements. Furthermore, it generates a 3D asset of the object by reconstructing the estimated components. This method makes it possible to place 3D assets with a scale approximating the real environment within a digital twin space and is expected to contribute to improving the verification accuracy of in-vehicle cameras for autonomous driving in virtual environments.
zh_title: 知识驱动的单图像尺寸估计——数字孪生构建的3D资产生成技术
translation: 在车载摄像头验证中，使用虚拟空间的模拟技术已经取得了进展，使得在各种场景中预评估误检和漏检成为可能。然而，虚拟和真实环境中被验证物体的尺度差异可能导致摄像头识别性能下降。对于安装在高空的交通标志，使用激光雷达或立体摄像头进行距离测量很困难，需要从单目图像进行尺寸估计。本文提出了一种通过将物体分解为多个结构元素并整合设计规则、几何关系和常规尺寸等外部知识来估计物体尺度的方法。具体而言，该方法从单目图像中检测每个组件，并通过考虑其结构关系和与周围元素的尺寸一致性来估计每个组件的大小。此外，它通过重建估计的组件来生成物体的3D资产。该方法使得在数字孪生空间中放置与真实环境规模相近的3D资产成为可能，并有望促进提高自动驾驶车载摄像头在虚拟环境中的验证精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种从单幅图像中通过分解物体并结合外部知识来估计物体尺寸并生成3D资产的方法，以提高自动驾驶车载摄像头在虚拟环境中的验证精度。
ai_comments: 本文的创新点在于将外部知识（设计规则、几何关系、常规尺寸）整合到单目图像的尺寸估计过程中，解决了传统方法在处理高空或难以测量的物体时的局限性。通过生成具有真实比例的3D资产，该方法为自动驾驶虚拟验证提供了更准确的数字孪生环境，具有重要的实际应用价值。
motivation: 在车载摄像头验证中，虚拟空间模拟技术已取得进展，但虚拟与真实环境中物体尺寸的差异会导致摄像头识别性能下降。对于高空交通标志，使用激光雷达或立体摄像头进行距离测量困难，需要从单目图像进行尺寸估计。
method: 该方法通过将物体分解为多个结构元素，并整合设计规则、几何关系和常规尺寸等外部知识来估计物体尺寸。具体而言，它从单目图像中检测每个组件，并通过考虑其结构关系和与周围元素的尺寸一致性来估计每个组件的大小。此外，它通过重建估计的组件来生成物体的3D资产。
results: 该方法可以在数字孪生空间中放置与真实环境规模相近的3D资产。
conclusion: 该方法有望提高自动驾驶车载摄像头在虚拟环境中的验证精度。

title: Curvature-Guided Module Localization for Low-Rank Detoxification of Backdoored Large Language Models
authors: Arash Raftari, Mehrdad Mahdavi, Nathan Blackthorn, Andrew Arash Mahyari
abstract: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs) by causing otherwise benign systems to produce attacker-specified malicious behavior when a hidden trigger is present. In this work, we study post hoc detoxification of backdoored LLMs in a practical setting where the defender has access to the poisoned model but does not wish to retrain the full network from scratch. We propose a mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules. We evaluate the method on poisoned variants of \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} with triggers inserted at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise benign prompts. Results show that the proposed approach substantially suppresses trigger-conditioned malicious responses while preserving benign model behavior. These findings suggest that backdoor removal in LLMs can be formulated as a localized structural repair problem rather than only a broad behavioral alignment problem.
zh_title: 曲率引导的模块定位用于后门大型语言模型的低秩解毒
translation: 后门攻击通过在存在隐藏触发器时导致原本良性的系统产生攻击者指定的恶意行为，对大型语言模型（LLMs）构成了严重威胁。在这项工作中，我们研究了在实际环境中对后门LLMs进行事后解毒的问题，即防御者可以访问受污染的模型，但不希望从头开始重新训练整个网络。我们提出了一种机制引导的权重空间修复框架，该框架首先使用激活修补和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析来定位参与传播触发诱导行为的模块，然后仅对最具影响力的模块应用有针对性的低秩修复。我们在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct的受污染变体上评估了该方法，这些变体在良性提示的开头、中间和结尾插入了触发器。结果表明，所提出的方法能够显著抑制触发条件下的恶意响应，同时保留模型的良性行为。这些发现表明，大型语言模型中的后门清除可以被表述为一个局部结构修复问题，而不仅仅是广义的行为对齐问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种曲率引导的模块定位方法，通过激活修补和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析来识别后门大型语言模型中传播触发行为的模块，然后应用有针对性的低秩修复，以在不从头开始重新训练的情况下，有效抑制恶意响应并保持良性行为。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个机制引导的权重空间修复框架，将后门清除问题视为一个局部结构修复问题，而非简单的行为对齐。通过曲率分析和低秩修复，实现了对后门LLMs的有效且高效的解毒，避免了昂贵的模型重训练。
motivation: 后门攻击对大型语言模型（LLMs）构成严重威胁，当存在隐藏触发器时，会导致良性系统产生攻击者指定的恶意行为。本文研究了在实际环境中对后门LLMs进行事后解毒的问题，即防御者可以访问受污染的模型，但不希望从头开始重新训练整个网络。
method: 提出了一种机制引导的权重空间修复框架。该框架首先利用激活修补和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析，定位参与传播触发诱导行为的模块，然后仅对最具影响力的模块应用有针对性的低秩修复。
results: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct的后门变体上进行了评估，结果表明所提出的方法能够显著抑制触发条件下的恶意响应，同时保留模型的良性行为。
conclusion: 这些发现表明，大型语言模型中的后门清除可以被表述为一个局部结构修复问题，而不仅仅是一个广义的行为对齐问题。

title: GRAPE: Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations for Interactive Medical Image Diagnosis
authors: Rasul Khanbayov, Hasan Kurban
abstract: Prototype-based medical image classifiers present three clinical limitations: they treat findings as independent, silently amplify unsafe physician feedback, and require full retraining whenever a new finding is needed. We present GRAPE (Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations), a unified architecture that addresses all three challenges. First, a Graph Attention Task Head models anatomical concept co-occurrence, boosting macro-F1 by +13.8,pp over the prototype baseline on TBX11K. Second, a Concept-Mismatch Safety Check - the first such mechanism in prototype-based medical classifiers - warns when the model's dominant finding inside a doctor-drawn region conflicts with the claimed label, catching 85% of erroneous annotations versus 51% for MC-Dropout with no extra inference cost. Third, Open-Vocabulary Prototype Anchoring aligns visual prototypes to clinical text, allowing a new finding to be added from a single labeled image without modifying any other component. On NIH ChestX-ray14, one Effusion example recovers full-supervision localization accuracy; on TBX11K, prototype maps achieve 2.6x better lesion localization than end-to-end baselines. All three capabilities add only +1~ms latency at interactive batch size. The project page is https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/GRAPE.
zh_title: GRAPE：用于交互式医学图像诊断的图增强原型解释
translation: 原型医学图像分类器存在三个临床局限性：它们将发现视为独立处理，无声地放大不安全的医生反馈，并且每次需要新发现时都需要完全重新训练。我们提出了GRAPE（图增强原型解释），一个统一的架构，解决了所有这三个挑战。首先，图注意力任务头对解剖概念的共现进行建模，在TBX11K上将宏F1比原型基线提高了+13.8个百分点。其次，概念不匹配安全检查——这是原型医学分类器中首个此类机制——在医生绘制区域内模型的主导发现与声称的标签冲突时发出警告，捕获了85%的错误注释，而MC-Dropout为51%，且没有额外推理成本。第三，开放词汇原型锚定将视觉原型与临床文本对齐，允许从单个标记图像添加新发现，而无需修改任何其他组件。在NIH ChestX-ray14上，一个胸腔积液示例恢复了全监督定位精度；在TBX11K上，原型图实现了比端到端基线好2.6倍的病灶定位。所有这三个功能在交互式批量大小下仅增加+1毫秒延迟。项目页面是https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/GRAPE。
tldr: GRAPE通过图注意力、概念不匹配安全检查和开放词汇原型锚定，解决了原型医学图像分类器在处理发现独立性、医生反馈放大和新发现添加方面的局限性。
ai_comments: GRAPE的创新性在于其统一的架构，同时解决了原型医学图像分类器在准确性、安全性和可扩展性方面的多个关键挑战。特别是概念不匹配安全检查机制，为临床应用提供了重要的安全保障。开放词汇原型锚定也极大地提高了模型的实用性，减少了在新发现加入时的开发成本。低延迟的特点也使其非常适合交互式诊断场景。
motivation: 原型医学图像分类器存在三个临床局限性：将发现视为独立、无声地放大不安全的医生反馈，以及每次需要新发现时都需要完全重新训练。
method: GRAPE（Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations）是一种统一架构，包含三个主要组件：1. 图注意力任务头：建模解剖概念共现，提升性能。2. 概念不匹配安全检查：当模型的主导发现与医生标注区域内的标签冲突时发出警告。3. 开放词汇原型锚定：将视觉原型与临床文本对齐，允许从单个标记图像添加新发现。
results: 1. 图注意力任务头在TBX11K上将宏F1提高了+13.8个百分点。2. 概念不匹配安全检查捕获了85%的错误注释，而MC-Dropout为51%，且没有额外推理成本。3. 开放词汇原型锚定在NIH ChestX-ray14上，一个胸腔积液示例恢复了全监督定位精度；在TBX11K上，原型图实现了比端到端基线好2.6倍的病灶定位。所有三个功能在交互式批量大小下仅增加+1毫秒延迟。
conclusion: GRAPE通过其创新架构解决了原型医学图像分类器的关键临床挑战，显著提高了诊断准确性、安全性并增强了可扩展性，同时保持低延迟。

title: The Quadruped Soft Tail: Compliant Grasping and Swabbing for Contamination Surveys in Harsh Environments
authors: Harald Minde Hansen, Nandita Gallacher, Kristin Y. Pettersen, Jan Tommy Gravdahl, Mario di Castro
abstract: Beryllium contamination surveys in radioactive areas are challenging for robots in environments cluttered with cables and electronics. To address this problem, we have developed a novel quadruped system augmentation: A lightweight, soft, and compliant tendon-actuated robotic tail mounted on a quadruped robot. The tail features a hollow, flexible backbone and a tendon-actuated soft gripper that enables the robot to pick up sampling tissues, swab contaminated surfaces, and release the tissues at designated collection locations for subsequent beryllium analysis. To enable intuitive teleoperation, a closed-form kinematic model and a singularity-robust task-space controller are developed. Experimental results demonstrate that gripper actuation has a negligible effect on robot shape, while common-mode tendon actuation provides an effective mechanism for stiffness modulation and preload control. Furthermore, experimental validation indicates that the proposed kinematic model provides a suitable basis for real-time task-space control. The proposed system combines the agility of legged locomotion with the compliance of soft robotic manipulation, enabling the complete contamination-survey procedure to be performed without human exposure. While motivated by beryllium contamination surveys at CERN, the proposed quadruped soft-tail concept is broadly applicable to legged robots operating in cluttered, confined, or hazardous environments where conventional rigid-link manipulators are undesirable.
zh_title: 四足软尾：恶劣环境下污染调查的柔顺抓取和擦拭
translation: 在电缆和电子设备杂乱的放射性区域中，铍污染调查对机器人来说极具挑战性。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种新型四足系统增强：一个安装在四足机器人上的轻量级、柔顺、肌腱驱动的机器人软尾。该软尾具有中空、柔性骨架和肌腱驱动的软抓手，能够拾取采样组织、擦拭受污染表面并在指定收集点释放组织，以便后续进行铍分析。为了实现直观的遥操作，开发了闭式运动学模型和奇异点鲁棒任务空间控制器。实验结果表明，抓手驱动对机器人形状的影响可以忽略不计，而共模肌腱驱动提供了一种有效的刚度调节和预载控制机制。此外，实验验证表明，所提出的运动学模型为实时任务空间控制提供了合适的基础。所提出的系统结合了腿式运动的敏捷性和软机器人操作的柔顺性，使得完整的污染调查程序无需人类暴露即可执行。虽然最初是为CERN的铍污染调查而设计，但所提出的四足软尾概念广泛适用于在杂乱、受限或危险环境中操作的腿式机器人，这些环境不适合传统的刚性连杆机械手。
tldr: 本文开发了一种用于四足机器人的轻量级、柔顺的肌腱驱动软尾，配备软抓手，能够在恶劣环境中进行污染调查，实现采样、擦拭和样本释放，并通过运动学模型和控制器实现直观遥操作。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将软机器人尾部系统集成到四足机器人上，有效解决了传统刚性机械臂在杂乱和危险环境中操作的局限性。其提出的结合腿式运动敏捷性和软操作柔顺性的方法，对于扩展机器人在复杂环境中的应用具有重要意义。特别是其对远程操作的关注和运动学模型的开发，提升了系统的实用性。
motivation: 在电缆和电子设备杂乱的放射性区域中，铍污染调查对机器人来说极具挑战性，需要避免人类暴露，因此需要一种能应对此类环境的柔顺操作系统。
method: 本文开发了一种新型四足系统增强：一个安装在四足机器人上的轻量级、柔顺、肌腱驱动的机器人软尾。该软尾具有中空、柔性骨架和肌腱驱动的软抓手，能够拾取采样组织、擦拭受污染表面并在指定收集点释放组织。为实现直观遥操作，开发了闭式运动学模型和奇异点鲁棒任务空间控制器。
results: 实验结果表明，抓手驱动对机器人形状影响可忽略不计；共模肌腱驱动提供了有效的刚度调节和预载控制机制。实验验证表明，所提出的运动学模型为实时任务空间控制提供了合适的基础。
conclusion: 该系统结合了腿式运动的敏捷性和软机器人操作的柔顺性，使得完整的污染调查程序无需人类暴露即可执行。尽管最初是为CERN的铍污染调查而设计，但所提出的四足软尾概念广泛适用于在杂乱、受限或危险环境中操作的腿式机器人，这些环境不适合传统的刚性连杆机械手。

title: How Human Feedback Shapes AI-generated Community Notes
authors: Soham De, Isaac Slaughter, Jiawei Guo, Qiao-Yun Cheng, Jiayuan Yan, Sruti Banerjee, Martin Saveski
abstract: Community Notes, a bridging-based crowd-sourced fact-checking system, has emerged as a new mechanism for moderating misleading information on social media and has been adopted by major platforms including X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and TikTok. Since its introduction, there has been an open question about what role AI could play in scaling and optimizing the system. Recently, X extended its Community Notes system by introducing Collaborative Notes: notes initially drafted by an LLM and iteratively refined based on feedback from human contributors. In this work, we systematically analyze the complete corpus of 19,146 collaborative notes and 211,850 instances of human feedback. First, we develop a taxonomy of human suggestions for improving AI-generated note drafts and find that suggestions involving factual corrections and additional context are most likely to be incorporated, while subjective policy judgments rarely are. Second, we examine changes in helpfulness across versions of collaborative notes and find that human feedback leads to more helpful notes, with the greatest impact coming from suggestions that challenge the main claim in the previous draft, particularly when submitted by more active contributors. Finally, we find that although collaborative notes improve through human feedback, they reach helpful status and are shown on the platform at lower rates than human-only or AI-only notes, with limited human participation emerging as a key bottleneck. Nevertheless, rather than serving as a weaker substitute, collaborative notes tend to play a complementary role, predominantly targeting posts that do not attract human-only or AI-only notes. Our analysis provides an initial description of efforts to use AI to improve crowdsourced content moderation in a real-world moderation system and outlines pathways for future improvements to such features.
zh_title: 人类反馈如何塑造AI生成的社区笔记
translation: 社区笔记是一种基于桥接的众包事实核查系统，已成为社交媒体上调节误导性信息的新机制，并已被X、Facebook、Instagram、Threads和TikTok等主要平台采纳。自推出以来，AI在扩展和优化该系统方面能发挥什么作用一直是一个开放性问题。最近，X通过引入协作笔记扩展了其社区笔记系统：这些笔记最初由大型语言模型（LLM）起草，并根据人类贡献者的反馈进行迭代完善。在这项工作中，我们系统分析了19,146条协作笔记和211,850条人类反馈实例的完整语料库。首先，我们开发了一种人类建议的分类法，用于改进AI生成的笔记草稿，发现涉及事实纠正和额外上下文的建议最有可能被采纳，而主观政策判断则很少被采纳。其次，我们检查了协作笔记不同版本间的有用性变化，发现人类反馈能带来更有用的笔记，其中对前一草稿主要主张提出挑战的建议影响最大，尤其当这些建议由更活跃的贡献者提交时。最后，我们发现尽管协作笔记通过人类反馈得到改进，但它们达到有用状态并在平台显示的比例低于纯人工或纯AI笔记，有限的人类参与是关键瓶颈。然而，协作笔记并非作为较弱的替代品，而是倾向于发挥补充作用，主要针对那些未吸引纯人工或纯AI笔记的帖子。我们的分析初步描述了在真实世界审核系统中利用AI改进众包内容审核的努力，并为未来此类功能的改进描绘了途径。
tldr: 本文系统分析了X平台上AI生成并经人类反馈迭代改进的协作笔记，发现人类反馈能提高笔记的有用性，尤其是事实纠正和额外上下文的建议。然而，协作笔记被采纳的比例低于纯人工或纯AI笔记，主要瓶颈在于人类参与度有限，但它们能补充覆盖其他笔记未触及的帖子。
ai_comments: 这项研究深入分析了AI与人类协作进行内容审核的实际效果，揭示了AI在生成初步内容方面的潜力，以及人类反馈在提升其质量和准确性方面的关键作用。论文创新性地构建了人类反馈分类法，并量化了不同类型反馈对笔记有用性的影响。其重要性在于为未来AI辅助众包审核系统的设计提供了实证依据和改进方向，特别是指出了人类参与度作为瓶颈以及协作笔记的补充价值。局限性可能在于其结果特定于X平台的实现，以及未能深入探讨如何有效激励和扩大人类参与度。
motivation: 社区笔记作为一种众包事实核查系统，在社交媒体上调节误导性信息方面发挥作用。随着AI技术的发展，研究AI在扩展和优化该系统中的作用成为一个开放性问题。X平台引入了由LLM起草并经人类反馈改进的协作笔记，本文旨在系统分析这种人类反馈如何塑造AI生成的社区笔记。
method: 本文系统分析了X平台上19,146条协作笔记的完整语料库和211,850条人类反馈实例。具体方法包括：1. 开发人类建议的分类法，以改进AI生成的笔记草稿。2. 检查协作笔记不同版本间的有用性变化。3. 比较协作笔记与纯人工或纯AI笔记的有用性及平台显示率。
results: 1. 事实纠正和额外上下文的建议最有可能被采纳，而主观政策判断很少被采纳。2. 人类反馈能提高笔记的有用性，其中挑战前一草稿主要主张的建议影响最大，尤其是由更活跃贡献者提交的建议。3. 尽管协作笔记通过人类反馈得到改进，但它们达到有用状态并在平台显示的比例低于纯人工或纯AI笔记，有限的人类参与是关键瓶颈。4. 协作笔记并非是较弱的替代品，而是起补充作用，主要针对未吸引纯人工或纯AI笔记的帖子。
conclusion: 人类反馈能够改进AI生成的社区笔记，使其更有用，尤其在事实纠正和提供额外上下文方面。然而，协作笔记在平台上的采纳率仍面临人类参与度有限的挑战。尽管如此，协作笔记通过补充覆盖其他笔记未触及的帖子，在真实世界的众包内容审核系统中发挥了重要作用，并为未来的改进提供了方向。

title: Demystify, Use, Reflect, Assess (DURA): An Experience Report on LLM Integration in CS2
authors: Margaret Ellis, Nikitha Donekal Chandrashekar, Sehrish Basir Nizamani, Mohammed Farghally, Jake O'Brien, Naren Ramakrishnan
abstract: Student access to Large Language Models (LLMs) is reshaping learning behaviors; at the same time students are entering the workforce where effective LLM use is becoming an expected skill. In this Experience Report we share our DURA framework (Demystify-Use-Reflect-Assess) and materials we used to restructure our CS2 course to allow the use of LLMs. We first demystified LLMs, then provided guidance on use with required attribution. We also added reflections related to LLM use at three points throughout the semester to encourage student meta-cognition around LLM use. We increased the value of proctored assessments in tandem with allowing retakes and including questions that explicitly assess skills from programming assignments. Students reported using LLMs for clarifying course concepts, debugging, understanding assignment guidelines, and determining test cases, but also still sought assistance via office hours and TAs, monitored Piazza, and reviewing course content. Students articulated thoughtful and strategic approaches to LLM use and also valued the instructional content and guidance from course staff. Student use of office hours increased slightly this semester and student perceptions that the instructor cares about them and their learning improved.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Experience report accepted to SIGCSE Virtual 2026
zh_title: 揭秘、使用、反思、评估 (DURA)：CS2 中 LLM 集成的经验报告
translation: 学生接触大型语言模型（LLM）正在重塑学习行为；与此同时，学生进入劳动力市场后，有效使用 LLM 正在成为一项预期技能。在本经验报告中，我们分享了 DURA 框架（揭秘-使用-反思-评估）以及我们用于重构 CS2 课程以允许使用 LLM 的材料。我们首先揭秘了 LLM，然后提供了使用指导并要求注明出处。我们还在整个学期的三个时间点增加了与 LLM 使用相关的反思，以鼓励学生围绕 LLM 使用进行元认知。我们提高了监考评估的价值，同时允许重考并纳入明确评估编程作业技能的问题。学生报告使用 LLM 来澄清课程概念、调试、理解作业指南和确定测试用例，但他们仍然通过办公时间、助教、Piazza 论坛和复习课程内容寻求帮助。学生阐述了深思熟虑且策略性的 LLM 使用方法，也重视课程工作人员的教学内容和指导。本学期学生使用办公时间略有增加，学生认为教师关心他们及其学习的看法有所改善。
tldr: 本经验报告分享了 DURA 框架，用于重构 CS2 课程以允许学生使用大型语言模型（LLM），并提供了使用指南、反思环节和评估调整。结果显示学生策略性地使用 LLM，并仍然重视教师指导，同时师生互动有所增加。
ai_comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个结构化的 DURA 框架，用于在计算机科学教育中负责任地整合 LLM，这对于应对当前 LLM 对教育的冲击具有重要意义。它不仅关注技术使用，还强调了反思和元认知，有助于培养学生批判性思维。研究结果表明，即使在 LLM 普及的情况下，教师指导和师生互动的重要性并未降低，反而可能通过适当的框架得到加强。

title: Why Solve It Twice? Hierarchical Accumulation of Skills for Transfer-Efficient ML Engineering
authors: Yongbin Kim, Yashar Talebirad, Osmar R. Zaiane
abstract: ML engineering agents waste compute rediscovering known techniques because every competition is a cold start. We present HASTE, a hierarchical multi-agent system that organizes cross-competition knowledge into three scope tiers (global, domain, and competition-specific), each coupled to a matching agent level. An orchestrator coordinates domain specialists and promotes learning between tiers via LLM-driven abstraction. A controlled ablation provides evidence for scoped loading: holding a 159-skill inventory constant across 8 competitions, tiered loading achieves a 100% medal rate while flat loading reaches only 62.5%, the same medal rate as loading no skills, and consumes 2x the output tokens. On the full MLE-Bench Lite benchmark (22 Kaggle competitions), HASTE reaches a medal rate of 77.3% using Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 12h per competition. In a cold-start run, the system begins with no accumulated skills. In warm-start runs, it reloads skills learned from earlier competitions, using only global and domain-level skills for transfer across competitions. Warm starts use 52% fewer refinement iterations, and the fraction of proposed changes kept by the agent rises from 42% at low inventory to 85% once 50+ skills are available. These results suggest that better knowledge organization can partly substitute for model strength and compute budget in ML-engineering agents.

zh_title: 为什么要解决两次？面向高效迁移的ML工程技能分层积累
translation: ML工程智能体因每次竞赛都是冷启动而浪费计算资源，重复发现已知技术。我们提出了HASTE，一个分层多智能体系统，将跨竞赛知识组织成三个范围层级（全局、领域和竞赛特定），每个层级都与一个相应的智能体级别耦合。一个协调器负责协调领域专家，并通过LLM驱动的抽象促进层级之间的学习。一项受控消融实验提供了范围加载的证据：在8场竞赛中保持159项技能库存不变，分层加载实现了100%的奖牌率，而扁平加载仅达到62.5%，与不加载技能的奖牌率相同，并消耗2倍的输出tokens。在完整的MLE-Bench Lite基准测试（22场Kaggle竞赛）中，HASTE使用Claude Sonnet 4.6以每场竞赛12小时的耗时达到了77.3%的奖牌率。在冷启动运行中，系统从零积累技能开始。在热启动运行中，它重新加载从早期竞赛中学到的技能，仅使用全局和领域级技能进行跨竞赛迁移。热启动使用的精炼迭代次数减少了52%，并且智能体保留建议更改的比例从低技能库存时的42%上升到拥有50多项技能时的85%。这些结果表明，更好的知识组织可以在ML工程智能体中部分替代模型强度和计算预算。
